question: Commonwealth Games 2022 was held in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Birmingham.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Commonwealth Games 2022** was held in** Birmingham, England,** from** 28 July to 8 August 2022.**
 
• This was the third time that the United Kingdom hosted the Commonwealth Games, following** London in 1934** and **Manchester in 2002.**
 
• The event featured **19 sports**, including the debut of women's T20 cricket, mixed synchronized diving, and wheelchair basketball 3x3.
 
• Over **4,500 athletes **from** 72 Commonwealth nations** and territories participated in the Games.
 
• The next Commonwealth Games will be held in** state of Victoria, Australia ****, in 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Beijing** is the capital city of China and has hosted the** Summer Olympics in 2008**.
 
• They were an **international multisport competition** that took place in Beijing, China, from** August 8–24, 2008. **
 
• **Tokyo** is the capital city of Japan and hosted the** Summer Olympics in 1964 and 2021.**
 
• They were an international multisport competition that took place in Tokyo, Japan, from **July 23 to August 8, 2021**, and from **October 10 to 24, 1964**.
 
• **New Delhi **is the capital city of India and hosted the **Commonwealth Games in 2010.**
 
• Held in Delhi, India, from** October 3–14, 2010,** it was an international multisport event for Commonwealth members.
